exact_level_stress._what: the measured limit of the exact near-term level: planner p99 against the number of requests inside the exact window, at a budget of 20 ms
exact_level_stress._register: MEASURED on this CPU, CONSTRUCTED load, request decisions only
exact_level_stress._crossing_is_a_magnitude_not_a_threshold: this runs on a shared CPU, so the depth at which p99 crosses 20 ms moves between repeats (128 has been measured both inside and outside the budget). Read the row table as an order of magnitude: the exact level is comfortable to a few tens of requests in the window and is not comfortable at a few hundred
exact_level_stress.headroom_note: if a live cell ever puts more than this many requests inside the exact window, NEAR_EXACT_S shrinks for the request kind and the shrink is reported as a measured limit, not tuned away (spec v5 section 10)

budget_verdict_at_32.caveat: the budget is a property of the live planner inside the harness; this measures the planner alone on a constructed load, so it is a NECESSARY and not a SUFFICIENT check
